product.name: Lenovo L18C4P71 Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for Lenovo ThinkPad T490 / T495 / P43s / T14 / P14s
product.description: Replacement battery (Model L18C4P71, FRU 02DL006, ASM SB10W87664) for Lenovo ThinkPad T490, ThinkPad T495, ThinkPad P43s, and select configurations of ThinkPad T14 Gen 1 (AMD/Intel) and ThinkPad P14s Gen 1. Also cross-compatible with L18L4P71 and L18M4P71. 4-cell, 51Wh, 15.36V Li-Ion. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
